crossRefs.note: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar. When all the people saw…
For when the flame went up toward the sky from off the altar, Yahweh’s angel ascended in the flame of the altar. Manoah…
Manoah said to his wife, “We shall surely die, because we have seen God.”
David lifted up his eyes, and saw Yahweh’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand…
Then I arose, and went out into the plain, and behold, Yahweh’s glory stood there, like the glory which I saw by the…
It was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to…
So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand…
I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them…
Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who…
For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength…
I fell to the ground, and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’
When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you…
We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

translations.web: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.
translations.bsb: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown in terror.
translations.kjv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
translations.asv: And when the disciples heard it, they fell on their face, and were sore afraid.
